info.title: MarketCheck Automotive Data API
info.description:
North American and UK automotive market data: live and historical vehicle listings, dealers, VIN decode, vehicle history, and price prediction.

Authentication: every request takes `api_key=YOUR_API_KEY` as a QUERY PARAMETER (not a header). Get a key at https://developers.marketcheck.com.

Quickstart: `curl "https://api.marketcheck.com/v2/search/car/active?api_key=YOUR_API_KEY&make=Toyota&model=Camry&zip=30301&radius=50"`

Rate limits: Free 500 calls/month at 5 rps; Basic 5,000/month at 5 rps; Standard pay-as-you-go at 40 rps; Enterprise custom. 429 responses carry Retry-After and RateLimit-*/Quota-* headers; the server timeout is 120 seconds.

Pagination: `start` + `rows` (rows max 50). Paging past your plan's deep-pagination limit returns HTTP 422; treat that as the end of results, not a retryable error.

More for AI coding assistants: https://developers.marketcheck.com/AGENTS.md (conventions file), https://developers.marketcheck.com/api/docs-mcp (docs MCP server), https://docs.marketcheck.com/llms.txt (docs index).

api_key.name: api_key
api_key.description: Your MarketCheck API key, sent as a query parameter on every request. Get one at https://developers.marketcheck.com/sign-up.

country.name: country
country.description: Specifies the country market used for ranking. Supported values: `us` or `ca`. Defaults to `us`.

include_generic.name: include_generic
include_generic.description: If `true`, includes generic VIN decode information in NeoVIN responses.

include_available_options.name: include_available_options
include_available_options.description: If `true`, includes available options details in NeoVIN responses.

country_v2.name: country
country_v2.description: Two-letter country code (as per ISO 3166-1 alpha-2). Default - `us`.

state.name: state
state.description: Two-letter state/province code required for US and Canada plates. Must be exactly two characters (e.g., `CA`, `TX`, `ON`).

city.name: city
city.description: Filters listings by city name (e.g. `Los Angeles`, `San Francisco`, `Houston`).

created_at_days.name: created_at_days
created_at_days.description: Filters dealerships by age in days since creation. Specify as `min-max` days. Alternative of `created_at_range`.

created_at_range.name: created_at_range
created_at_range.description: Filters dealerships by creation date. Specify as `YYYYMMDD-YYYYMMDD`. Alternative of `created_at_days`.

dealer_type.name: dealer_type
dealer_type.description: Filters dealers by type. Allowed values — `franchise`, `independent`.

facets.name: facets
facets.description: Field name to return bucket facets for. Accepts multiple fields as a comma-separated list.

latitude.name: latitude
latitude.description: Latitude component of the search location (decimal degrees). Used for geospatial queries along with `longitude` and `radius` parameters.

listing_count_range.name: listing_count_range
listing_count_range.description: Filters dealerships by the count of active listings. Specify as `min-max`.

longitude.name: longitude
longitude.description: Longitude component of the search location (decimal degrees). Used for geospatial queries along with `latitude` and `radius` parameters.

country_v3.name: country
country_v3.description: Filters listings by country code. Allowed values - `us`, `ca`, `all`. Default — `us`.

msa_code.name: msa_code
msa_code.description: Filters listings by Metropolitan Statistical Area (MSA) code.

radius.name: radius
radius.description: Search radius around the specified location in miles. Used with `zip` or `latitude` and `longitude` for geospatial queries.

range_facets.name: range_facets
range_facets.description: Comma-separated list of numeric field names for which to return range facets in the response.

rows.name: rows
rows.description: Number of results to return per request. Default — 10. Maximum — 50.

sort_by.name: sort_by
sort_by.description: Field to sort results by. If omitted, defaults to distance when a location filter is used.

sort_order.name: sort_order
sort_order.description: Specifies result sort order. Allowed values — `asc` or `desc`. Default — `asc`.

start.name: start
start.description: Pagination offset (0-based). Default — 0. Maximum page is limited to 10,000/`rows`.

state_v2.name: state
state_v2.description: Filters listings by US or Canadian state/province code (e.g., `CA`, `NY`, `ON`). Accepts multiple codes separated by commas.

zip.name: zip
zip.description: Filters listings within the specified 5-digit ZIP code.

county.name: county
county.description: Filters listings by county name (e.g. `Greater London`, `Lancashire`). Use instead of `state`. Accepts multiple counties as comma-separated values.

fca_status.name: fca_status
fca_status.description: FCA authorization status for dealers. (e.g., `Authorised`, `Appointed Representative`, `Registered`). Accepts multiple values as a comma-separated list.

postal_code.name: postal_code
postal_code.description: Filters listings within the specified postal code (e.g., `M5H 2N2`).

rows_v2.name: rows
rows_v2.description: Number of results to return per request. Default — 10. Maximum — 10.

mc_category.name: mc_category
mc_category.description: Filters listings by MarketCheck category code. Case-insensitive.

mc_dealer_id.name: mc_dealer_id
mc_dealer_id.description: Filters listings by MarketCheck dealer ID.

mc_dealership_group_id.name: mc_dealership_group_id
mc_dealership_group_id.description: Filters listings by MarketCheck dealership group ID.

mc_dealership_group_name.name: mc_dealership_group_name
mc_dealership_group_name.description: Filters listings by dealership group name.

mc_location_id.name: mc_location_id
mc_location_id.description: Filters listings by MarketCheck location ID.

mc_rooftop_id.name: mc_rooftop_id
mc_rooftop_id.description: Filters listings by MarketCheck rooftop ID.

mc_sub_dealership_group_id.name: mc_sub_dealership_group_id
mc_sub_dealership_group_id.description: Filters listings by MarketCheck sub-dealership group ID.

mc_sub_dealership_group_name.name: mc_sub_dealership_group_name
mc_sub_dealership_group_name.description: Filters listings by sub-dealership group name.

mc_website_id.name: mc_website_id
mc_website_id.description: Filters listings by MarketCheck website ID.

append_api_key.name: append_api_key
append_api_key.description: If `true`, the response URLs (such as cached images & relevant links) include the `api_key` query parameter along with value; if `false`, they do not. Default — `true`.

base_ext_color.name: base_ext_color
base_ext_color.description: The base exterior color to filter results by (e.g. White, Black, Blue, Silver, Red). Accepts multiple colors as a comma-separated list.

base_exterior_color.name: base_exterior_color
base_exterior_color.description: Alias for `base_ext_color`. Filters by base exterior color (comma-separated list).

base_int_color.name: base_int_color
base_int_color.description: The base interior color to filter results by (e.g. Black, Brown, Beige, Red). Accepts multiple colors as a comma-separated list.

base_interior_color.name: base_interior_color
base_interior_color.description: Alias for `base_int_color`. Filters by base interior color (comma-separated list).

body_subtype.name: body_subtype
body_subtype.description: Filters listings by body subtype (e.g., Crew, Extended, Regular, Extended Crew). Accepts multiple values separated by commas.

body_type.name: body_type
body_type.description: Filters listings by body type (e.g., SUV, Pickup, Sedan, Hatchback, Convertible). Accepts multiple values separated by commas.

car_type.name: car_type
car_type.description: Filters listings by inventory type. Allowed values - `new`, `used`, `certified`.

city_mpg_range.name: city_mpg_range
city_mpg_range.description: Filters listings by city fuel-economy mileage. Specify as `min-max` MPG (e.g., `20-35`).

cylinders.name: cylinders
cylinders.description: Filters listings by engine cylinder count (e.g., `4`, `6`, `8`). Accepts multiple values as a comma-separated list.

dealer_id.name: dealer_id
dealer_id.description: Filters listings by MarketCheck dealer ID.

dealer_name.name: dealer_name
dealer_name.description: Filters listings by dealer name (case-insensitive complete match, substring not supported).

dealership_group_name.name: dealership_group_name
dealership_group_name.description: Filters listings by the name of the dealership group. Accepts multiple values as a comma-separated list.

dom_180_range.name: dom_180_range
dom_180_range.description: Filters listings by Days on Market observed over the last 180 days. Specify as `min-max` days (e.g., `10-50`).

dom_active_range.name: dom_active_range
dom_active_range.description: Filters listings by active Days on Market (DOM). Specify as `min-max` days.

dom_range.name: dom_range
dom_range.description: Filters listings by total Days on Market (DOM). Specify as `min-max` days.

doors.name: doors
doors.description: Filters listings by number of doors (e.g., `2`, `4`). Accepts multiple values as comma-separated list.

dos_active_range.name: dos_active_range
dos_active_range.description: Filters listings by active Days on Site (DOS). Specify as `min-max` days.

drivetrain.name: drivetrain
drivetrain.description: Filters listings by drivetrain (`FWD`, `RWD`, `4WD`). Accepts multiple values separated by commas.

engine.name: engine
engine.description: Filters listings by engine designation (e.g., `2.0L I4`, `3.5L V6`, `2.5L H4`). Accepts multiple values as comma-separated list.

engine_aspiration.name: engine_aspiration
engine_aspiration.description: Filters listings by engine aspiration (`Turbocharged`, `Naturally Aspirated`, etc.). Accepts multiple values separated by commas.

engine_block.name: engine_block
engine_block.description: Filters listings by engine block layout (`V`, `I`, `H`). Accepts multiple values separated by commas.

engine_size.name: engine_size
engine_size.description: Filters listings by engine displacement size (e.g., `2.0`, `2.5`, `3.5`). Accepts multiple values separated by commas.

engine_size_range.name: engine_size_range
engine_size_range.description: Filters listings by engine displacement size. Specify as `min-max` liters (e.g., `1.5-3.0`).

exterior_color.name: exterior_color
exterior_color.description: Filters listings by exterior color (e.g. `White`, `Summit White`, `Gun Metallic`). Accepts multiple values as comma-separated list.

facet_sort.name: facet_sort
facet_sort.description: Sorts facet buckets. Allowed values — `count` (descending count, default) or `index` (alphabetical).

first_seen_at_mc_days.name: first_seen_at_mc_days
first_seen_at_mc_days.description: Filters listings by the number of days since they were first seen by MarketCheck. Specify as `min-max` days. Alternative of `first_seen_at_mc_range`.

first_seen_at_mc_range.name: first_seen_at_mc_range
first_seen_at_mc_range.description: Filters listings by the date they were first seen by MarketCheck. Specify as `YYYYMMDD-YYYYMMDD` (e.g., `20220523-20220631`). Alternative of `first_seen_at_mc_days`.

first_seen_at_source_days.name: first_seen_at_source_days
first_seen_at_source_days.description: Filters listings by the number of days since first seen on the source site. Specify as `min-max` days. Alternative of `first_seen_at_source_range`.

first_seen_at_source_range.name: first_seen_at_source_range
first_seen_at_source_range.description: Filters listings by date first seen on the source site. Specify as `YYYYMMDD-YYYYMMDD`. Alternative of `first_seen_at_source_days`.

first_seen_days.name: first_seen_days
first_seen_days.description: Filters listings by the number of days since they were first seen in MarketCheck inventory. Specify as `min-max` days. Alternative of `first_seen_range`.

first_seen_range.name: first_seen_range
first_seen_range.description: Filters listings by the first seen date. Specify as `YYYYMMDD-YYYYMMDD` (e.g., `20220523-20220631`). Alternative of `first_seen_days`.

fuel_type.name: fuel_type
fuel_type.description: Filters listings by fuel type (e.g., `Unleaded`, `Diesel`, `Electric`, `Premium Unleaded`, `Electric / Unleaded`). Accepts multiple values separated by commas.

highway_mpg_range.name: highway_mpg_range
highway_mpg_range.description: Filters listings by highway fuel-economy mileage. Specify as `min-max` MPG (e.g., `25-40`).

in_transit.name: in_transit
in_transit.description: If `true`, returns listings marked as in transit; if `false` or omitted, no in-transit filter is applied.

include_non_vin_listings.name: include_non_vin_listings
include_non_vin_listings.description: If `true`, includes listings without a VIN; if `false`, such listings are excluded. Default — false.

include_relevant_links.name: include_relevant_links
include_relevant_links.description: If `true`, includes relevant links to other MarketCheck API endpoints in the response. Default — false.

interior_color.name: interior_color
interior_color.description: Filters listings by interior color. Accepts multiple values as comma-separated list.

last_seen_days.name: last_seen_days
last_seen_days.description: Filters listings by the number of days since last seen. Specify as `min-max` days. Alternative of `last_seen_at_range`.

last_seen_range.name: last_seen_range
last_seen_range.description: Filters listings by last seen date. Specify as `YYYYMMDD-YYYYMMDD` (e.g., `20220523-20220631`). Alternative of `last_seen_at_days`.

make.name: make
make.description: Filters listings by vehicle make (e.g., `Toyota`, `Ford`, `Mercedes-Benz`). Accepts multiple values as comma-separated list.

miles_range.name: miles_range
miles_range.description: Filters listings by odometer reading. Specify as `min-max` miles (e.g., `1000-50000`).

min_photo_links.name: min_photo_links
min_photo_links.description: Filters listings with at least the specified number of photo links (e.g. `3`, `8`).

min_photo_links_cached.name: min_photo_links_cached
min_photo_links_cached.description: Filters listings with at least the specified number of cached photo links (e.g. `3`, `8`).

model.name: model
model.description: Filters listings by specific vehicle model (e.g., `Camry`). Accepts multiple values separated by commas.

msrp_range.name: msrp_range
msrp_range.description: Filters listings by Manufacturer's Suggested Retail Price (MSRP). Specify as `min-max` USD (e.g., `20000-45000`).

owned.name: owned
owned.description: When used with `dealer_id`, `mc_website_id`, or `source`, `true` returns listings actually owned by that dealer. Default — false.

photo_links.name: photo_links
photo_links.description: If `true`, returns only listings that contain at least one photo link. Default — false.

photo_links_cached.name: photo_links_cached
photo_links_cached.description: If `true`, returns only listings that contain cached photo links. Default — false.

powertrain_type.name: powertrain_type
powertrain_type.description: Filters listings by powertrain type (e.g., `Combustion`, `BEV`, `HEV`, `MHEV`, `PHEV`). Accepts multiple values separated by commas.

price_range.name: price_range
price_range.description: Filters listings by advertised price in USD. Specify as `min-max` (e.g., `1000-50000`).

rows_v3.name: rows
rows_v3.description: Number of results to return per request. Default — 1500. Maximum — 1500.

seating_capacity.name: seating_capacity
seating_capacity.description: Filters listings by seating capacity (e.g., `2`, `5`, `7`). Accepts multiple values separated by commas.

stats.name: stats
stats.description: Comma-separated list of numeric fields for which to return aggregate statistics (mean, max, min, count).

stock_no.name: stock_no
stock_no.description: Filters listings by dealer stock number.

transmission.name: transmission
transmission.description: Filters listings by transmission type (`Automatic`, `Manual`, etc.). Accepts multiple values separated by commas.

trim.name: trim
trim.description: Filters listings by vehicle trim (e.g., `EX`, `Limited`). Accepts multiple values separated by commas.

vehicle_type.name: vehicle_type
vehicle_type.description: Filters listings by vehicle type (`Truck`, `Car`). Accepts multiple values separated by commas.

version.name: version
version.description: Filters listings by vehicle version name.

vin.name: vin
vin.description: Filters listings by full 17-character Vehicle Identification Number (VIN).

year.name: year
year.description: Filters listings by model year (e.g., `2020`). Accepts multiple years separated by commas.

has_price.name: has_price
has_price.description: Boolean param to filter listings that have a price (true) or no price (false).

has_miles.name: has_miles
has_miles.description: Boolean param to filter listings that have a miles (true) or no miles (false).

year_range.name: year_range
year_range.description: Filters listings by model year range. Specify as `min-max` (e.g., `2015-2025`).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in History API response.

page.name: page
page.description: Page number for paginated History API results. Default — 1.

sort_order_v2.name: sort_order
sort_order_v2.description: Specifies result sort order for historical data. Allowed values — `asc` or `desc`. Default — `desc`.

redirect_to_active.name: redirect_to_active
redirect_to_active.description: If `true`, redirects to the active version of the listing if it has been updated.

redirect_to_latest.name: redirect_to_latest
redirect_to_latest.description: If `true`, redirects to the latest version of the listing if it has been updated.

carfax_1_owner.name: carfax_1_owner
carfax_1_owner.description: If `true`, returns only vehicles with a single previous owner; if `false` or omitted, no ownership filter is applied. Default — false.

carfax_clean_title.name: carfax_clean_title
carfax_clean_title.description: If `true`, returns only vehicles with a clean title history; if `false` or omitted, no title filter is applied. Default — false.

debug.name: debug
debug.description: If `true`, returns applied year, make, model, and trim filters in the response. Default — false.

exact.name: exact
exact.description: If `true`, performs exact matching (upto build_code level) in MDS API queries. If `false`, performs partial matching (upto model level). Default — false.

exclude_certified.name: exclude_certified
exclude_certified.description: If `true`, excludes certified-pre-owned vehicles from results. Default — false. See `car_type` parameter for filtering by inventory type for certified vehicles.

finance_down_payment.name: finance_down_payment
finance_down_payment.description: Filters listings by finance down-payment amount in USD. Specify a single value or a `min-max` range.

finance_down_payment_per.name: finance_down_payment_per
finance_down_payment_per.description: Filters listings by finance down-payment percentage. Specify a single value or `min-max`.

finance_emp.name: finance_emp
finance_emp.description: Filters listings by finance Estimated Monthly Payment (EMP) in USD. Specify a single value or `min-max`.

finance_loan_apr.name: finance_loan_apr
finance_loan_apr.description: Filters listings by finance loan APR. Specify a single value or `min-max`.

finance_loan_term.name: finance_loan_term
finance_loan_term.description: Filters listings by finance loan term in months. Specify a single value or `min-max` months.

include_sold.name: include_sold
include_sold.description: If `true`, includes array of sold VINs in MDS API responses. Default — false.

lease_down_payment.name: lease_down_payment
lease_down_payment.description: Filters listings by lease down-payment amount in USD. Specify a single value or `min-max`.

lease_emp.name: lease_emp
lease_emp.description: Filters listings by lease Estimated Monthly Payment (EMP) in USD. Specify a single value or `min-max`.

lease_term.name: lease_term
lease_term.description: Filters listings by lease term length in months. Specify a single value or `min-max`.

ymmt.name: ymmt
ymmt.description: Year-Make-Model-Trim composite string(s). Each combo uses pipe separators and combinations can be comma-separated. For example, `2019|Toyota|Camry|LE,2020|Honda|Civic|EX`. Useful for finding multiple groups of similar cars. Alternatively, you can use `vins` or `taxonomy_vins` for VIN-based queries.

car_type_v2.name: car_type
car_type_v2.description: Inventory status for popular cars statistics. Allowed values — `new`, `used`. Required.

state_v3.name: state
state_v3.description: Filters popular cars statistics by US state code. 2-letter code (e.g., `FL`, `CA`).

city_state.name: city_state
city_state.description: City and state for popular cars statistics, pipe-separated (e.g., `jacksonville|FL`).

country_v4.name: country
country_v4.description: Country for popular car queries (`us` or `ca`). Default — `us`.

city_v3.name: city
city_v3.description: City of the vehicle location. Either `zip` or `city` and `state` must be provided for price prediction.

dealer_type_v2.name: dealer_type
dealer_type_v2.description: Dealer type for price prediction. Allowed values — `franchise`, `independent`. Required.

is_certified.name: is_certified
is_certified.description: If `true`, treats the vehicle as certified for price prediction. Default — false.

miles.name: miles
miles.description: Current mileage of the vehicle. Required for price prediction.

state_v4.name: state
state_v4.description: State of the vehicle location (2-letter code, e.g. `CA`). Either `zip` or `city` and `state` must be provided for price prediction.

vin_v2.name: vin
vin_v2.description: VIN of the car for MarketCheck price prediction (17 characters). Required.

zip_v2.name: zip
zip_v2.description: ZIP code of the vehicle location. Either `zip` or `city` and `state` must be provided for price prediction.

vrm.name: vrm
vrm.description: VRM of the vehicle for MarketCheck price prediction. Required.

postal_code_v2.name: postal_code
postal_code_v2.description: Postal code of the vehicle location. Required.

make_v2.name: make
make_v2.description: The vehicle make for sales statistics queries.

mm.name: mm
mm.description: The Make-Model (`mm`) combination for sales statistics, pipe-separated (e.g., `ford|f-150`).

ymm.name: ymm
ymm.description: Year-Make-Model (`ymm`) group for sales statistics, pipe-separated (e.g., `2015|ford|f-150`).

ymmt_v2.name: ymmt
ymmt_v2.description: Year-Make-Model-Trim (`ymmt`) combination for sales statistics, pipe-separated.

taxonomy_vin.name: taxonomy_vin
taxonomy_vin.description: The taxonomy VIN (aka squish VIN) for sales statistics queries.

vin_v3.name: vin
vin_v3.description: The full VIN (17 characters) to be transformed into a taxonomy VIN for statistics.

state_v5.name: state
state_v5.description: US state code for state-level sales statistics. 2-letter code (e.g., `FL`, `CA`).

city_state_v2.name: city_state
city_state_v2.description: City and state for city-level sales statistics, pipe-separated (e.g., `jacksonville|FL`).

country_v5.name: country
country_v5.description: Country for which to retrieve sales statistics. Allowed values — `us`, `ca`. Default — `us`.

dedup.name: dedup
dedup.description: If `true`, returns only `is_searchable` listings irrespective of `dealer_id`, `mc_website_id`, or `source`. Default — false. See `nodedup` for the opposite behavior.

exclude_dealer_ids.name: exclude_dealer_ids
exclude_dealer_ids.description: Excludes results from the specified dealer IDs. Accepts multiple values as a comma-separated list.

exclude_high_value_features.name: exclude_high_value_features
exclude_high_value_features.description: Excludes listings that contain any of the specified High-Value Features (HVFs). Accepts comma-separated HVFs.

exclude_make.name: exclude_make
exclude_make.description: Excludes the specified makes. Accepts multiple values as a comma-separated list.

exclude_mc_website_ids.name: exclude_mc_website_ids
exclude_mc_website_ids.description: Excludes results from the specified MarketCheck website IDs. Accepts multiple values as comma-separated list.

exclude_options_packages.name: exclude_options_packages
exclude_options_packages.description: Excludes listings containing the specified Options Packages (OPs). Accepts multiple values as comma-separated list.

exclude_sources.name: exclude_sources
exclude_sources.description: Excludes listings from the specified sources (e.g., `autonation.com`, `carmax.com`). Accepts multiple values as comma-separated list.

high_value_features.name: high_value_features
high_value_features.description: Filters listings that include all specified High-Value Features (HVFs). Provide HVFs as a comma-separated list.

include_finance.name: include_finance
include_finance.description: If `true`, only listings with finance offers are returned. Default — false.

include_lease.name: include_lease
include_lease.description: If `true`, only listings with lease offers are returned. Default — false.

include_preferred_dealer_flag.name: include_preferred_dealer_flag
include_preferred_dealer_flag.description: If `true`, adds a `preferred_dealer` flag to listings when they match client-specific filters. Default — false.

inventory_count_range.name: inventory_count_range
inventory_count_range.description: Filters dealers by total listing count. Specify as `min-max` listings (e.g., `10-100`).

match.name: match
match.description: Comma-separated list of field names for exact matching in combination with `vins`. Allowed values — year, make, model, trim, version, build_code, options_packages. Example: `year,make,model` or `year,make,model,trim,version`.

mm_v2.name: mm
mm_v2.description: Make-Model composite string from the auto-complete API. Pass the value exactly as returned (e.g., `toyota|camry`).

nodedup.name: nodedup
nodedup.description: If `true`, returns all duplicate listings for a VIN; if `false` (default), duplicate listings are removed. This is the opposite of `dedup`.

options_packages.name: options_packages
options_packages.description: Filters listings by Options Packages (OPs). Provide a comma-separated list; results include listings containing all specified OPs.

plot.name: plot
plot.description: If `true`, returns up to 1000 listings for plotting instead of full listing details.

preferred_dealers.name: preferred_dealers
preferred_dealers.description: If `true`, flags listings in response from preferred dealers based on client scoring. Default — false.

preferred_dealers_only.name: preferred_dealers_only
preferred_dealers_only.description: If `true`, returns listings only from preferred dealers. Default — false.

price_change.name: price_change
price_change.description: Filters listings by positive or negative price-change flag (e.g., `positive`, `negative`). Accepts multiple comma-separated values.

price_change_range.name: price_change_range
price_change_range.description: Filters listings by the price change in USD. Since price changes can be positive or negative, specify as `min|max` (e.g., `-5000|1000`). This is a range filter.

taxonomy_vins.name: taxonomy_vins
taxonomy_vins.description: Comma-separated list of 10-character “squish” VINs (first 8 + 10th & 11th chars). Filters listings by build.

vdp_url.name: vdp_url
vdp_url.description: Filters listings by Vehicle Detail Page (VDP) URL match.

vins.name: vins
vins.description: The VINs to find similar cars around. Accepts a comma-separated list of VINs. Used in conjunction with the `match` parameter always. Similar parameters are `ymmt` and `taxonomy_vins`.

vehicle_status.name: vehicle_status
vehicle_status.description: Filters listings by vehicle status (e.g., `Available`, `Coming Soon`).

buy_now_price_range.name: buy_now_price_range
buy_now_price_range.description: Filters listings by advertised buy now price in USD. Specify as `min-max` (e.g., `1000-50000`).

facet_min_count.name: facet_min_count
facet_min_count.description: Minimum document count for a facet bucket to be returned.

field.name: field
field.description: The field name for which to perform auto-completion.

ignore_case.name: ignore_case
ignore_case.description: If `true`, the auto-complete search is case-insensitive. Default — true.

input.name: input
input.description: The text input string used for auto-completion queries.

seller_type.name: seller_type
seller_type.description: Filters auto-complete suggestions by seller type. Allowed values — `dealer`, `fsbo`, `auction`.

term_counts.name: term_counts
term_counts.description: If `true`, includes term frequency counts in the response. Default — false.

acquisition_fee_range.name: acquisition_fee_range
acquisition_fee_range.description: Filters listings by acquisition fee amount. Specify as `min-max` in USD (e.g., `500-1500`).

apr_range.name: apr_range
apr_range.description: Filters listings by Annual Percentage Rate (APR). Specify as `min-max` (e.g., `0-9.99`).

base_sha.name: base_sha
base_sha.description: The SHA-256 hash of an incentive offer used as the comparison baseline.

cashback_amount_range.name: cashback_amount_range
cashback_amount_range.description: Filters listings by cashback amount specified in the offer. Specify as `min-max` in USD.

cashback_target_group.name: cashback_target_group
cashback_target_group.description: Filters cashback offers by target group (e.g. `Military personnel`, `College graduates`). Accepts multiple groups as comma-separated values.

dealer_contribution_range.name: dealer_contribution_range
dealer_contribution_range.description: Filters listings by dealer contribution amount in USD. Specify as `min-max` (e.g., `1000-5000`).

disposition_fee_range.name: disposition_fee_range
disposition_fee_range.description: Filters listings by lease disposition fee in USD. Specify as `min-max`. (e.g., `0-500`).

down_payment_range.name: down_payment_range
down_payment_range.description: Filters finance or lease offers by down-payment amount in USD. Specify as `min-max`.

due_at_signing_range.name: due_at_signing_range
due_at_signing_range.description: Filters lease offers by “due at signing” amount in USD (sum of first month, down payment, acquisition fee). Specify as `min-max`. (e.g., `0-500`).

gross_cap_cost_range.name: gross_cap_cost_range
gross_cap_cost_range.description: Filters listings by gross capitalized cost in USD. Specify as `min-max`.

lease_end_purchase_price_range.name: lease_end_purchase_price_range
lease_end_purchase_price_range.description: Filters lease offers by residual value (purchase price at lease end) in USD. Specify as `min-max`.

mileage_limit_range.name: mileage_limit_range
mileage_limit_range.description: Filters offers by mileage limit specified in lease terms. Specify as `min-max` miles.

monthly_range.name: monthly_range
monthly_range.description: Filters listings by monthly payment amount in USD (commonly in lease offers). Specify as `min-max` (e.g., `200-500`).

net_cap_cost_range.name: net_cap_cost_range
net_cap_cost_range.description: Filters listings by net capitalized cost in USD (post-discount lease amount). Specify as `min-max`.

offer_type.name: offer_type
offer_type.description: Filters incentive offers by type. Allowed values — `lease`, `finance`, `cash`.

over_mileage_fee_range.name: over_mileage_fee_range
over_mileage_fee_range.description: Filters lease offers by per-mile surcharge for exceeding included mileage. Specify as `min-max` USD.

scraped_at_date_range.name: scraped_at_date_range
scraped_at_date_range.description: Filters listings by the first seen date. Specify as `YYYYMMDD-YYYYMMDD`. Alias for `first_seen_range`.

security_deposit_range.name: security_deposit_range
security_deposit_range.description: Filters lease offers by security deposit amount in USD. Specify as `min-max`.

status_date_range.name: status_date_range
status_date_range.description: Filters offers by last seen date. Specify as `YYYYMMDD-YYYYMMDD`.

term_range.name: term_range
term_range.description: Filters finance/lease offers by term length. Specify as `min-max` numeric value; units defined by `term_unit`.

total_monthly_payments_range.name: total_monthly_payments_range
total_monthly_payments_range.description: Filters lease offers by total monthly payments over the term in USD. Specify as `min-max`.

valid_from_range.name: valid_from_range
valid_from_range.description: Filters offers by “valid from” date. Specify as `YYYYMMDD-YYYYMMDD`.

valid_through_range.name: valid_through_range
valid_through_range.description: Filters offers by “valid through” date. Specify as `YYYYMMDD-YYYYMMDD`.

active_inventory_date_range.name: active_inventory_date_range
active_inventory_date_range.description: Filters listings active at least once within the specified date range. Specify as `YYYYMMDD-YYYYMMDD` (e.g., `20190523-20190623`).

expired.name: expired
expired.description: If `true`, returns listings of expired VINs (i.e., VINs that are no longer active in the market for sale); if `false`, returns expired listings of VINs that are still active.

sold.name: sold
sold.description: If `true`, returns listings that are inferred to be sold by MarketCheck.

append_api_key_v2.name: append_api_key
append_api_key_v2.description: If `true`, the response URLs (such as cached images & relevant links) include the `api_key` query parameter along with value; if `false`, they do not. Default — `false`.

car_location_city.name: car_location_city
car_location_city.description: City of the car location. Used for filtering by specific car location city.

car_location_county.name: car_location_county
car_location_county.description: County of the car location. Used for filtering by specific car location county.

car_location_latitude.name: car_location_latitude
car_location_latitude.description: Latitude of the car location (decimal degrees). Used for geospatial queries of car location.

car_location_longitude.name: car_location_longitude
car_location_longitude.description: Longitude of the car location (decimal degrees). Used for geospatial queries of car location.

car_location_seller_name.name: car_location_seller_name
car_location_seller_name.description: Seller name at car location. Used for filtering by specific seller name at car location.

car_location_street.name: car_location_street
car_location_street.description: Street address of the car location. Used for filtering by specific car location street address.

car_location_zip.name: car_location_zip
car_location_zip.description: Postal code of the car location. Used for filtering by specific car location postal code.

co2_emissions.name: co2_emissions
co2_emissions.description: Filters listings by CO2 emissions rating in g/km. Specify as a single value or `min-max` range (e.g., `0-120`).

combined_mpg_range.name: combined_mpg_range
combined_mpg_range.description: Filters listings by combined fuel-economy mileage. Specify as `min-max` MPG (e.g., `40-65`).

country_v6.name: country
country_v6.description: Filters listings by UK country code. Allowed values - `uk`, `england`, `scotland`, `wales`, `northern_ireland`.

ev_battery_capacity_range.name: ev_battery_capacity_range
ev_battery_capacity_range.description: Filters electric vehicles by battery capacity. Specify as `min-max` kWh (e.g., `40-100`).

ev_battery_type.name: ev_battery_type
ev_battery_type.description: Filters electric vehicles by battery type (e.g., `Lithium-ion`, `Nickel-metal hydride`). Accepts multiple values as comma-separated list.

ev_vehicle_range.name: ev_vehicle_range
ev_vehicle_range.description: Filters electric vehicles by driving range. Specify as a single value or `min-max` miles (e.g., `200-400`).

exclude_sources_v2.name: exclude_sources
exclude_sources_v2.description: Excludes listings from the specified sources (e.g., `arnoldclark.com`, `cinch.co.uk`). Accepts multiple values as comma-separated list.

exclude_write_off_category.name: exclude_write_off_category
exclude_write_off_category.description: Excludes listings with specified write-off categories (e.g., `Category A`, `Category B`, `Category S`, `Category N`). Accepts multiple values as comma-separated list.

fuel_type_v2.name: fuel_type
fuel_type_v2.description: Filters listings by fuel type (e.g., `Petrol`, `Diesel`, `Electric`, `Petrol Electric Hybrid`). Accepts multiple values separated by commas.

insurance_group.name: insurance_group
insurance_group.description: Filters listings by UK insurance group rating (e.g., `E`, `15E`, etc). Accepts multiple values as comma-separated list.

is_vat_included.name: is_vat_included
is_vat_included.description: If `true`, returns listings where VAT is included in the price; if `false`, returns listings where VAT is excluded. Default — no filter applied.

match_v2.name: match
match_v2.description: Comma-separated list of field names for exact matching in combination with `vrm`. Allowed values — `year`,`make`,`model`,`variant`,`body_type`,`drivetrain`,`transmission`,`fuel_type`.

model_variant.name: model_variant
model_variant.description: Filters listings by specific vehicle model variant (e.g., `320d M Sport`, `C220d AMG Line`). Accepts multiple values as comma-separated list.

msrp_range_v2.name: msrp_range
msrp_range_v2.description: Filters listings by Manufacturer's Suggested Retail Price (MSRP). Specify as `min-max` GBP (e.g., `20000-45000`).

nodedup_v2.name: nodedup
nodedup_v2.description: If `true`, returns all duplicate listings for a VRM; if `false` (default), duplicate listings are removed. This is the opposite of `dedup`.

num_owners.name: num_owners
num_owners.description: Filters listings by number of previous owners.

performance_co2_range.name: performance_co2_range
performance_co2_range.description: Filters listings by CO2 performance rating. Specify as `min-max` range (e.g., `0-150`).

powertrain_type_v2.name: powertrain_type
powertrain_type_v2.description: Filters listings by powertrain type. Accepts multiple values separated by commas.

price_change_range_v2.name: price_change_range
price_change_range_v2.description: Filters listings by the price change in GBP. Since price changes can be positive or negative, specify as `min|max` (e.g., `-5000|1000`). This is a range filter.

price_range_v2.name: price_range
price_range_v2.description: Filters listings by advertised price in GBP. Specify as `min-max` (e.g., `1000-50000`).

state_v6.name: state
state_v6.description: Alias for `county`. Filters listings by state/county (e.g., `Greater London`, `Lincolnshire`). Accepts multiple values as a comma-separated list.

trim_v2.name: trim
trim_v2.description: Alias of `variant`. Filters listings by vehicle trim (e.g., `EX`, `Limited`). Use `variant` instead. Accepts multiple values separated by commas.

ulez_compliant.name: ulez_compliant
ulez_compliant.description: If `true`, returns listings that are ULEZ (Ultra Low Emission Zone) compliant. Default — false.

uvc_id.name: uvc_id
uvc_id.description: Filters listings by Unique Vehicle Code identifier. Used for matching specific vehicle configurations.

variant.name: variant
variant.description: Alias of `trim`. Filters listings by vehicle variant identifier. Accepts multiple values as comma-separated list.

vehicle_registration_date_range.name: vehicle_registration_date_range
vehicle_registration_date_range.description: Filters listings by vehicle registration date. Specify as `YYYYMMDD-YYYYMMDD` (e.g., `20200101-20231231`).

vehicle_registration_mark.name: vehicle_registration_mark
vehicle_registration_mark.description: Alias of `vrm`. Filters listings by Vehicle Registration Mark (VRM/number plate). Use instead of `vrm`. Accepts multiple values as comma-separated list.

vrm_v2.name: vrm
vrm_v2.description: Filters listings by Vehicle Registration Mark (VRM/number plate). Use instead of `vehicle_registration_mark`. Accepts multiple values as comma-separated list.

wheelbase_category.name: wheelbase_category
wheelbase_category.description: Filters listings by wheelbase category (e.g., `SWB`, `LWB`). Accepts multiple values as comma-separated list.

write_off_category.name: write_off_category
write_off_category.description: Filters listings by write-off category classification (e.g., `Category A`, `Category B`, `Category S`, `Category N`). Accepts multiple values as comma-separated list.

ymmt_v3.name: ymmt
ymmt_v3.description: Year-Make-Model-Trim composite string(s). Each combo uses pipe separators and combinations can be comma-separated. For example, `2019|Ford|Fiesta|Zetec,2020|Ford|Fiesta|St-line`. Useful for finding multiple groups of similar cars. Alternatively, you can use `vrm` and `match` for VRM-based queries.

expired_v2.name: expired
expired_v2.description: If `true`, returns listings of expired VRMs (i.e., VRMs that are no longer active in the market for sale); if `false`, returns expired listings of VRMs that are still active.

category.name: category
category.description: Filters listings by Heavy Equipment category (e.g. `Agriculture`, `Construction`, `Crane`). Accepts multiple categories as comma-separated values.

hours_used_range.name: hours_used_range
hours_used_range.description: Filters listings by hours used in the case of Heavy Equipment. Specify as `min-max` hours (e.g., `100-500`).

search_text.name: search_text
search_text.description: Text substring search within listing titles, descriptions, and other fields. Use `tokenized_search_text` instead for tokenized search.

sub_category.name: sub_category
sub_category.description: Filters RV listings by their sub-category (e.g., `Travel Trailer`, `Fifth Wheel`). Accepts multiple values as a comma-separated list.

class.name: class
class.description: Filters listings by RV class type (e.g., `Class A`, `Class B`, `Class C`). Accepts multiple values as a comma-separated list.

gvwr.name: gvwr
gvwr.description: Filters listings by Gross Vehicle Weight Rating (GVWR) in pounds. Specify as a single value or `min-max` range (e.g., `5000-10000`).

length.name: length
length.description: Filters listings by vehicle length in inches.

length_range.name: length_range
length_range.description: Filters listings by vehicle length in inches. Specify as `min-max` inches (e.g., `150-250`).

model_o.name: model_o
model_o.description: Filters listings by model orig (as described on the webpage). Accepts multiple values as comma-separated list.

number_of_awnings.name: number_of_awnings
number_of_awnings.description: Filters listings by the number of awnings. Accepts multiple values as a comma-separated list.

slideouts.name: slideouts
slideouts.description: Filters listings by the number of slideouts. Accepts multiple values as a comma-separated list.

sleeps.name: sleeps
sleeps.description: Filters listings by the number of sleeping areas. Specify as min-max range (e.g., `1-4`).

tokenized_search_text.name: tokenized_search_text
tokenized_search_text.description: Tokenized search within listing titles, descriptions, and other fields. Use this instead of `search_text` for exact matches.

sort_by_v2.name: sort_by
sort_by_v2.description: Field to sort RV auto-complete results. Allowed values - `index` (default) or `count`.

availability_status.name: availability_status
availability_status.description: Filters listings by their availability status (e.g., `Due in`, `sold`, `pending`). Accepts multiple statuses as a comma-separated list.

berths.name: berths
berths.description: Filters listings by the number of berths in the RV (e.g., `2`, `4`, `6`). Accepts multiple values as a comma-separated list.

chassis.name: chassis
chassis.description: Filters listings by chassis type (e.g. `Ford`, `Chevrolet`, `Mercedes-Benz`). Accepts multiple values as a comma-separated list.

drive_type.name: drive_type
drive_type.description: Filters listings by drive type (e.g., `AWD`, `FWD`, `RWD`, `4WD`). Accepts multiple values as a comma-separated list.

exterior_length_range.name: exterior_length_range
exterior_length_range.description: Filters listings by exterior length in inches. Specify as `min-max` inches (e.g., `150-250`).

interior_length_range.name: interior_length_range
interior_length_range.description: Filters listings by interior length in inches. Specify as `min-max` inches (e.g., `100-200`).

mtplm.name: mtplm
mtplm.description: Filters listings by Maximum Technically Permissible Laden Mass (MTPLM) in pounds.

steering.name: steering
steering.description: Filters listings by steering type (e.g., `power steering`). Accepts multiple values separated by commas.

width_range.name: width_range
width_range.description: Filters listings by vehicle width in inches. Specify as `min-max` inches (e.g., `60-80`).

RateLimit-Limit.description: Requests allowed per second on your plan.

RateLimit-Remaining.description: Requests remaining in the current rate window.

Quota-Limit.description: Monthly call quota on your plan.

Quota-Remaining.description: Calls remaining in the current month.

Quota-Reset-Time.description: When the monthly quota resets (ISO timestamp).

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before retrying. Can be large when the monthly quota, not the per-second rate, is exhausted.

Error422.description: Validation error, including paging past the plan's deep-pagination limit (treat as end of results).

Error429.description: Rate limit or monthly quota exceeded. Honor Retry-After; distinguish RateLimit-* (per-second) from Quota-* (per-month) headers.
